item: Rider ring (two halves with ears and tang)
spec: 12 mm mild steel round bar, two half rings on a 112 mm mean diameter (100 mm inside), 2 mm gap at each joint; four ears 6 x 25 x 42 mm flat bar with 8.5 mm holes; tang 6 x 28 x 84 mm flat bar on the fixed half with 10.5, 6.5 and 2.1 mm holes; welded, then hot-dip galvanised (line 18)
notes: About 0.40 m of bar and 0.25 m of 6 x 30 flat bar. Mass about 0.58 kg

spec: M8 x 30 stainless hex bolt, nyloc nut, two washers
notes: Permanent hinge between the two ring halves

spec: 8 x 30 mm stainless clevis pin with an R-clip and a 300 mm lanyard of 3 mm cord tied through the R-clip and the ear
notes: The only part removed to open the ring; the lanyard keeps it from being lost

spec: 38 x 3 mm steel tube 120 mm long; 38 mm disc of 6 mm plate welded across one end; two fork cheeks 6 x 30 x 69 mm flat bar welded under the disc 8 mm apart, 2.1 mm shear pin hole; 6.5 mm lock pin hole through the tube; hot-dip galvanised (line 18)
notes: Mass about 0.56 kg

spec: 2.0 mm soft aluminium wire (1050 or 1100 alloy, O temper), cut 30 mm long; one fitted, eleven spare; all pins from one reel, which is calibrated before use
notes: 1 m of wire makes 30 pins (USD 3 a metre). Rated 300 N in double shear (calculated), to be confirmed on CalRig

spec: Seasoned bamboo culm about 35 mm outside, 1,450 mm long, cut between nodes so each end is closed by a node; borax-boric soak and oil finish against rot; 6.5 mm cross holes for the lock pins as drawn
notes: Local production variant (SMR-DDR-003, D-A4 C); about 0.55 kg each (0.38 kg/m, estimate); stiffness varies culm to culm and is checked at TRL 4

spec: Mild steel tube about 40 mm inside, 200 mm long, sleeved over the joint and pinned; galvanised with line 18
notes: Local production variant; about 0.12 kg each; replace the aluminium sleeves

spec: 4.8 mm stainless steel blind rivets, grip range 4 to 6 mm
notes: Not used in the local production variant: the ferrules are pinned, not riveted

spec: 6 x 50 mm stainless clevis pins with R-clips and short lanyards
notes: Two pole joints, the pole head, and the jigging weight

spec: Rubber end cap for 32 mm tube, 30 mm deep
notes: Stops water entering the pole and gives a grip

spec: 6 mm braided polyester cord, 10 m, about 600 kg breaking strength; ends heat-sealed
notes: Tied to the ring tang with a bowline; the free end is tied to a thwart while working

spec: 40 mm closed-cell polyethylene foam, 300 x 120 mm with a 30 x 60 mm notch at each end; painted orange
notes: Floats the ring and cord if dropped (1.26 kg of lift). Mass about 0.04 kg

spec: Polyethylene vial 14 mm across, 80 mm long, with cap; tied to the winder
notes: Holds the eleven spare shear pins dry

spec: 50 mm mild steel round bar 60 mm long; two fork cheeks 6 x 30 x 66 mm flat bar welded to one end face 8 mm apart, 6.5 mm pin hole; hot-dip galvanised (line 18)
notes: Mass about 1.1 kg with its pin. Pinned to the tang with a lock pin (line 9) in place of the pole for snags beyond pole reach. Local production variant: one shared by five canoes at a landing, so one fifth a kit

spec: 4 mm steel plate: saddle bent to a U, 100 mm long, 70 mm inside, 70 mm legs; two cheeks 60 x 70 mm welded on the web 84 mm apart with 13 mm axle holes; M10 nut welded over a 11 mm hole in the inboard leg; hot-dip galvanised (line 18)
notes: Mass about 0.94 kg with the nut. Local production variant: one shared by five canoes at a landing, so one fifth a kit

spec: HDPE rod 60 mm diameter cut 80 mm long, bored 13 mm; M12 x 110 galvanised bolt with nyloc nut; two 24 mm washers 2 mm thick between roller and cheeks
notes: Roller turns freely on the bolt; mass about 0.34 kg. Local production variant: one shared by five canoes at a landing, so one fifth a kit

spec: M10 galvanised threaded rod 100 mm, 30 mm pad disc of 5 mm plate welded on one end, 8 mm bar T-handle 70 mm welded on the other
notes: Clamps gunwales 30 to 60 mm thick. Local production variant: one shared by five canoes at a landing, so one fifth a kit

spec: Ring, pole head, jigging weight, crutch frame and clamp pad; about 2.8 kg of steel at a galvaniser's minimum-lot share
notes: Local production variant: the crutch and weight share of the lot (USD 6.00) is spread over five canoes, USD 4.80 less a kit

spec: Orange enamel, 100 ml, and black enamel for lettering: float winder, pole top 300 mm, the rating mark and the interim rule on the pole head (ONLY CANOES 7 m OR LONGER WITH 3 CREW)
notes: Makes a dropped part easy to see, shows the pin rating and prints the interim rule on canoes (SMR-DDR-003, D-A2 A)

spec: Welding rods, cutting and flap discs, drill bits 2.1, 4.9, 6.5, 8.5, 11 and 13 mm
notes: Share of consumables for one kit

spec: 6 x 28 mm mild steel flat bar 50 mm long, 2.1 mm shear pin hole 10 mm from the top and 10.5 mm tether hole 26 mm below it; 12 mm mild steel round bar about 150 mm, bent to a J of 28 mm radius (44 mm throat) and welded under the flat; hot-dip galvanised with line 18
notes: Mass about 0.19 kg. Pins into the pole-head fork with a shear pin in place of the ring, to pull the bight of a wrapped net back round the branch (SMR-DDR-003, D-A1 B); tried beside the ring in the TRL 4 staged-snag trials
